C_P_init.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; 0.0597 mM = mean cortical tissue PO2 47 mmHg (celayaalcala2021simulation, reference conditions) x O2 solubility 1.27 uM/mmHg (fang2008oxygen, Bunsen coefficient 1.27e-15 umol um^-3 mmHg^-1 = 1.27e-3 mol m^-3 mmHg^-1); illustrative starting value

flux_c.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; 4.46e-16 mol/s = |M| x V_P (0.0558 mM/s x 8e-15 m3), i.e. capillary supply equal to the maximal consumption of the nominal 20 um cell; set by the capillary module in a network

V_P.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; 8e-15 m^3 = a 20 um cube (order of the intercapillary half-spacing); a discretisation choice

M.data_reference: celayaalcala2021simulation; Table 1 maximal O2 demand M0 = 7.5 cm3 O2 per 100 cm3 per min (rat cortex) = 1.25e-3 cm3 O2 cm^-3 s^-1 x 4.4615e-5 mol/cm3 O2 (STP, 22.414 L/mol) = 5.58e-2 mol m^-3 s^-1 = 0.0558 mM/s, negative because M enters dC_P/dt with a plus sign (consumption)

C50.data_reference: celayaalcala2021simulation; Michaelis constant P0 = 10.5 mmHg (Table 1), x O2 solubility 1.27 uM/mmHg (fang2008oxygen) = 0.0133 mM. With secomb2020mass's solubility 3.89e-5 cm3 O2/(cm3 mmHg) = 1.74 uM/mmHg it would be 0.0182 mM; the library converts PO2 with fang2008oxygen throughout

J_in.data_reference: definitional; 0 when nothing is connected to this sum: no flux into a side with no face (a closed side)

J_out.data_reference: definitional; 0 when nothing is connected to this sum: no flux out of a side with no face (a closed side)
